items.exampleEn: The incident happened at about ten p.m.
items.exampleZh: 這起事件發生在晚上十點左右。

items.exampleEn: The temple bell rings at the time of evening prayer.
items.exampleZh: 寺廟的鐘在晚禱時間響起。

items.exampleEn: The school teaches students to respect racial differences.
items.exampleZh: 學校教學生尊重種族差異。

items.exampleEn: The priest lives next to the church.
Friday is a holy day for some people.
items.exampleZh: 對某些人來說，星期五是神聖的日子。

items.exampleEn: Discrimination at work is against the law here.
items.exampleZh: 在這裡，職場歧視是違法的。
經濟學幫助我們了解物價。

items.sentenceEn: This garden is like heaven on earth.
items.sentenceZh: 這座花園就像人間天堂。

items.audioEn: The economics lecture has moved to Room 8, because Room 3 is too small.
items.audioZh: 經濟學的課換到 8 號教室，因為 3 號教室太小了。
options: The lights in Room 3 are broken.

items.sentenceEn: The police are looking into the incident.
items.sentenceZh: 警方正在調查這起事件。

items.sentenceEn: My father says economics is not just about money.
items.sentenceZh: 我爸爸說經濟學不只是跟錢有關。

items.stemEn: The ____ walked slowly to the front of the church and lit the candles.
items.stemZh: 神父慢慢走到教堂前面點蠟燭。

items.stemEn: Refusing to serve people because of their skin color is ____ discrimination.
items.stemZh: 因為膚色而拒絕服務別人是種族歧視。

items.passageEn: Last Sunday, my grandmother took me to the Sunday service at her church in the mountains. It is a historic church, and the priest welcomed us and showed us a holy book that is three hundred years old. My grandmother said a short prayer for our family. She said that heaven must be a quiet place like this church. Near the door, a sign said that the church welcomes people of every racial background, and discrimination is not allowed. On the way home, there was a small incident: our bus broke down, but nobody was hurt.
items.passageZh: 上週日，奶奶帶我去她在山上的教堂做禮拜。那是一座具歷史意義的教堂，神父歡迎我們，還給我們看一本三百年前的聖書。奶奶為我們全家做了一段簡短的禱告。她說天堂一定是個像這座教堂一樣安靜的地方。門口附近有個告示寫著，這座教堂歡迎所有種族背景的人，不允許歧視。回家路上發生了一個小事故：我們的公車故障了，不過沒有人受傷。

questions.questionZh: 回家路上發生了什麼小事故？
options: 公車故障了但沒人受傷

items.promptZh: 這家公司不允許任何歧視。
referenceEn: This company does not allow any discrimination.
No discrimination is allowed at this company.
rubricZh: discrimination 表示「歧視」，是不可數名詞，例如 allow discrimination 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 economics 造一個句子，說說你對經濟學的看法或經驗。
referenceEn: I think economics is a difficult subject.
I want to study economics in the future.
rubricZh: economics 表示「經濟學」，是不可數名詞，例如 study economics 等說法
說的是自己的看法或經驗（例如 I）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）
